<title level="1" right="Action">[Tongue Grab](/Actions.aspx?ID=2790) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 93

</column>

---

The giant frog lashes out with its tongue, making a tongue Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is automatically [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) by the giant frog and pulled into a square adjacent to the frog. The grabbed condition lasts until the end of your next turn.
name: Tongue Grab
